bundledAssets.name: Clark Realtime UI Video Upscaler x2
bundledAssets.modifications: The runtime exposes an unavailable getter. It uses explicit browser globals. It destroys the GPU device if initialization fails. Model weights and WGSL do not change.

bundledAssets.name: Apple Cursor artwork
bundledAssets.modifications: Extract SVG path attributes and hotspots into apple-shapes.json. Apply runtime fill, outline, scale and shadow. The generated artifact source hash identifies the source set in identity.json.

bundledAssets.name: Pixi Filters source image kernels v6.1.5
bundledAssets.modifications: Adapt adjustment, clamped Kawase blur and bloom for the existing compositor device. Add Sniptale monochrome, sepia, sharpen, pixelate, vignette and deterministic grain. Reconstruct canonical source texels before interpolation. Use explicit logical coordinates, project time and valid premultiplied alpha. Provide an independent CPU image reference.
